Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX Version for session, i.e. 'FIX.4.4'

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of bytes in the message body.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Identifies FIX message type.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number. Must be set to 'Y' for messages sent in response to a Resend Request from Coinbase Derivatives

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: Session ID and SubFirmID Session ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent SubFirmID. Example: EBR123 Session ID: EBR SubFirmID: 123 From Exchange: Value from order entry tag 56-TargetCompID - "COIND"

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the end trader submitting orders. Tag 50 IDs are issued by an exchange clearing member firm (clearing member), their contracted vendors or assignees

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Timestamp of the message leaving the client system.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies entity receiving the message = "COIND" From Exchange Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: Session ID and SubFirmID. Session ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent SubFirmID. Example: EBR123 Session ID: EBR SubFirmID: 123

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies destination exchange system - "PROD" or "TEST"From Exchange: Echo back Tag57 sent by client system

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For resent messages only, contains timestamp from tag 52-SendingTime from original message.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always last tag in message. Functions as end-of-message delimiter.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: "0" - None. Security must be guaranteed on transport level

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: "N" - use previous sequences "Y" - reset sequences (start new session). If clients cannot recover the previous session they start new session with 1 and set this field to "Y". The flag should be used with caution especially during trading session as this might lead to business data loss

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Logout reason

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the first message in range to be resent

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last message in range to be resent

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: "N" - sequence reset, the counterparty must adjust inbound sequence number. "Y" - indicates the message is used instead of administrative or business messages which are not to be resent

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New adjusted sequence number

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier to be returned in resulting Heartbeat message

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier to be returned in resulting Heartbeat message

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the rejected message

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Error message

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Reject reason code. See Session Reject Reason Codes (tag 373).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Unique account identifier.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order identifier assigned by client system. Client system must maintain uniqueness of this value for the life of the order.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Contains cumulated traded quantity throughout lifespan of an order.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique exchange assigned identifier of the execution

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique exchange assigned order identifier

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity of order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Indicates order status. See OrderStatus (tag 39) "1" - Partial Fill "2" - Complete Fill

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order types. See order types (Tag40)

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Last accepted ClOrdID in the order chain.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price per single contract unit. All Execution Report messages sent in response to Market orders (with protection) and Stop orders (with protection) will include tag 44-Price populated with the Protection Price Limit (best available price +/- the protection points). If the order is not completely filled, the remaining Open Quantity will rest on the order book at the Protection Price Limit. Note: Fo

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. See Order Sides (Tag54)

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: This tag contains the details of the instrument. Future Example: EUM20

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Indicates security type. See Security Type (Tag167)

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. If not present, DAY order is the default. See Order TimeInForce (Tag59)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: UTC format YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.sss

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Indicates type of execution report. See ExecType (tag 150). Always "F" for Trade

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Amount of contracts remaining for execution after this fill.

Field.Name: ManualOrderIndicator
Field.Description: Value sent on inbound message from client system indicating the order as sent manually or generated by automated trading logic.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Defines source of original order. See CustOrderHandlingInst (tag1031)

Field.Name: TrdMatchID
Field.Description: Match Identifier: can be used to link sides of a match

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price at which order was filled.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity filled.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Indicates date of trade reference in this message in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: TotalNumSecurities
Field.Description: Contains the number of Leg Fill Acknowledgment messages sent with the spread summary. Sent for spread fill message only.

Field.Name: MultiLegReporting
Field.Description: Indicates if acknowledgment message is sent for an outright, leg of spread or spread. See MultiLegReporting (tag 442)

Field.Name: SecondaryExecID
Field.Description: Exchange assigned unique identifier; can be used to link spread summary fill notice with leg fill notice and trade cancel messages.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: The type of business conducted. 0 = Customer/Agency 1 = Principal

Field.Name: CustOrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the customer. Used to indicate the Customer Type Indicator (CTI) Code. See CustOrderCapacity (tag582)

Field.Name: AggressorIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates if order was incoming or resting for the match event. See AggressorIndicator (tag 1057)

Field.Name: RequestTime
Field.Description: Information carried on a response to convey the time (UTC) when the request was received by Exchange UTC format YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.sss

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Contains unique ID for the trade being cancelled

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Stop price of the order. Required for stop and stop-limit orders.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed. This tag is used only when tag 59-TimeInForce=4 (Fill and Kill).

Field.Name: MaxShow
Field.Description: Display quantity of an order to be shown in the order book at any given time.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Identifies origin of the order elimination. See ExecRestatementReason (tag 378)

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Contains business date when order expires.

Field.Name: RequestTime
Field.Description: Information carried on a response to convey the time (UTC) when the request was received by the Exchange

Field.Name: SelfMatchPreventionId
Field.Description: This tag is required when market participants elect to use the optional Self Match Prevention functionality.

Field.Name: SelfMatchPreventionInstruction
Field.Description: Indicates a cancel instruction when Self Match Prevention is triggered. To use tag 8000-SelfMatchPreventionStrategy, client systems must include tag 7928-SelfMatchPreventionID on the originating message See SelfMatchPreventionStrategy (tag 8000)

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text explanation of error code.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Indicates date of trade reference in this message in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Error code. See OrdRejReason (tag 103)

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Indicates date of trade reference in this message in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: RequestTime
Field.Description: Information carried on a response to convey the time (UTC) when the request was received by Exchange UTC format YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.sss

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Sent in the Order Elimination message if the originating order was an FAK/FOK/MinQty that contained tag 110-MinQty.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Requiredonly if tag 59-TimeInForce=Good Till Date (GTD). Note: For spread trade Execution Reports, this tag is sent in the Execution Report - Fill Notice (35=8, 39=1 or 2) for the spread only and not the legs of the spread.

Field.Name: SelfMatchPreventionId
Field.Description: This tag is required when market participants elect to use the optional Self Match Prevention functionality.

Field.Name: SelfMatchPreventionInstruction
Field.Description: This tag is required when market participants elect to use the optional Self Match Prevention functionality.

Field.Name: RequestTime
Field.Description: Information carried on a response to convey the time (UTC) when the request was received by Exchange UTC format YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.sss

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Party identifier/code

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: 447 = D (Proprietary)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: 1 - Subfirm code 4 - Clearing Firm Code 11 - Order Originating Trader 55 - Session ID
